about.heading: A bit about me
about.bio_1: I'm a Software Engineering graduate from Eastern Mediterranean University (ABET-accredited, full scholarship, February 2026). I work as a freelance full-stack engineer, currently building Zylicon -- a B2B fleet management and telematics platform -- using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and a Supabase (PostgreSQL) cloud backend with Deno-based serverless Edge Functions.
about.bio_2: I led the AI and Backend side of our graduation project, which won the faculty's Best Project Award. It was a Cyprus grocery price comparison platform built with RAG architecture, fuzzy search algorithms, and a smart basket optimizer. I've also done internships in industrial computer vision (YOLOv8) and enterprise inventory management (.NET Core).
about.bio_3: I enjoy working where product complexity meets engineering precision -- from designing multi-tenant RLS policies and real-time telemetry pipelines to building clean, accessible UIs and AI-powered workflows.

zylicon.title: Zylicon -- B2B Fleet Management & Telematics
zylicon.description: A production B2B fleet management and telematics platform for driver safety and fleet risk management. Built from the ground up with React, TypeScript, Vite, and a Supabase cloud backend featuring ~95 serverless Edge Functions, real-time live tracking, and AI-powered driver insights.
zylicon.long_description: Zylicon is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform serving fleet managers and drivers through a web dashboard and a Flutter mobile app. As the lead full-stack engineer, I designed and implemented the entire system from schema to UI. The backend runs on PostgreSQL with strict Row Level Security (RLS) for multi-tenant data isolation, PL/pgSQL RPC functions, database triggers for audit logging, and ~95 Deno-based serverless Edge Functions covering trip lifecycle, 5Hz telemetry ingestion, rule-based scoring workers, mobile API contracts, and AI-powered insights. On the frontend I built a real-time live tracking map (MapLibre GL), a driver scoring dashboard, a ruleset studio, fleet and vehicle management flows, and a permission architecture driven by an automated state-machine. The app supports full TR/EN localization and light/dark themes.
highlights: Production platform live at zylicon.app -- built and maintained solo as lead engineer
Real-time vehicle tracking with MapLibre GL and Supabase Realtime WebSockets
~95 Deno serverless Edge Functions covering trip lifecycle, telemetry, scoring, and mobile APIs
Multi-tenant Row Level Security (RLS), RPC functions, and database triggers for audit logging
Automated driver scoring engine: 5Hz telemetry ingestion, 15-second event windows, ruleset v2
AI-powered driver insights and fleet risk analysis via Gemini and GPT integrations
TDD with Vitest (React components, hooks) and pgTAP (PostgreSQL schema and RLS)
Mobile backend contracts (Flutter): bootstrap, trip, vehicle, and score APIs

market.title: AI Integrated Market Price Comparison
market.description: An award-winning, AI-powered system architecture built for dynamic price comparison. Engineered a .NET 8 Web API with Clean Architecture, integrated with Gemini 2.5 Flash using a RAG pipeline for natural language search, and developed a custom Smart Basket Optimization algorithm.
market.long_description: As the Team Leader & Backend/AI Developer for this award-winning platform, I architected the backend using .NET 8, ASP.NET Core Web API, and Clean (Onion) Architecture to ensure high scalability. The system utilizes Entity Framework Core and SQL Server on AWS RDS. I engineered a RAG Pipeline and AI Intent Parsing mechanism bridging the Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API with our database for real-time shopping decisions. Additionally, I developed a custom asynchronous Smart Basket Optimization algorithm to calculate the cheapest market combinations, and implemented a Fuzzy Matching Engine (Levenshtein Distance) to handle typos across massive datasets.
highlights: Best Project Award -- Faculty of Computer Engineering, EMU
RAG-based AI assistant answers natural language price queries in real time
Smart Basket Optimizer finds the cheapest market combination for a given shopping list
Fuzzy product matching via Levenshtein Distance handles typos and spelling variants
Web scraping aggregates live prices from multiple Cyprus supermarkets
Selenium, JMeter & Postman tested -- follows OWASP Top 10 security standards
Built with .NET 8 REST API + React frontend, designed with Agile across 8 work packages

conveyor.title: YOLOv8 Conveyor Overflow Detection
conveyor.description: A real-time computer vision system deployed at Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi to detect material overflow on conveyor belts, preventing equipment damage and safety hazards.
conveyor.long_description: Developed during my internship at Bursa Cimento Fabrikasi, this system uses YOLOv8 to monitor conveyor belts in real-time via camera feeds. When overflow or anomalies are detected, the system triggers automated alerts to prevent costly equipment damage and safety incidents.

tofas.title: TOFAS Spare Parts Inventory Control
tofas.description: An internal inventory management system built during my internship at TOFAS Turk Otomobil Fabrikasi A.S., one of Turkey's largest automotive manufacturers, for tracking spare parts stock.
tofas.long_description: During my internship at TOFAS, I developed an internal web application for managing spare parts inventory across the production line. The system handles full CRUD operations, stock level tracking, low-stock alerts, and reporting dashboards. Built with .NET Core and Entity Framework Core, with automated database migrations via SQLite.

wala.title: WALA -- WhatsApp Like Application
wala.description: A secure real-time messaging application built with WebSockets as part of a security engineering course. Features encrypted client-server communication.
wala.long_description: Built for a security engineering course, WALA is a full-stack messaging application demonstrating secure WebSocket communication patterns. The project focused on security protocols, message integrity, authentication, and real-time bidirectional communication between multiple clients through a central server.
